newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TNT opens new Eindhoven centre on 100pct g.
newsitem.headline: TNT opens new Eindhoven centre on 100pct g.

text.p: TNT Express worldwide has opened a new centre in Eindhoven after business has more than doubled in the past five years.
"Five years ago our Dutch company carried 691,000 consignments, while last year the total was 2.1m," said Charles Graham, chief financial officer of the company in a statement.

The new branch employs 220 people and can handle 20,000 shipments a week. It covers an area of 3,800 square metres including 36 ramps, a new conveyor belt and a computerised system for checking weight and volume. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
